events.title: Hinton, Bengio, and LeCun share Turing Award
events.summary: Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton, and Yann LeCun won the 2018 ACM Turing Award for [deep learning] breakthroughs.
events.about: The trio spent decades on backpropagation, CNNs, and representation learning before industry adoption. Their award recognized [neural network]s as foundational computer science, not a abandoned fad.

narrative.whyChosen: The 2018 Turing Award canonized [deep learning]'s founding researchers.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated decades of [neural network] research after multiple AI winters.
narrative.problemSolved: [Neural network] research lacked mainstream recognition despite practical success.

events.title: Contentstack founded
events.summary: Neha Sampat, Nishant Patel, and Matthew Baier founded Contentstack in 2018 — an enterprise headless CMS spun out from Raw Engineering.
events.about: Contentstack targets Fortune 500 omnichannel content — [API]-first, MACH Alliance founding member, with workflows for global marketing teams. It competes with Contentful and Adobe Experience Manager for enterprise DXP budgets.

narrative.whyChosen: Contentstack became a leading enterprise headless CMS for omnichannel content.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated headless CMS as an enterprise DXP category, not just a developer tool.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises needed governed, multi-locale content APIs without monolithic CMS lock-in.

events.title: Builder.io founded
events.summary: Steve Sewell and Brent Locks founded Builder.io in 2018 — a visual headless [CMS] that connects drag-and-drop editing to any frontend stack.
events.about: Builder.io lets marketers compose pages from developer-defined React components without code — A/B testing, personalization, and visual editing on top of headless architecture. Customers include Allbirds, Harry's, and Warby Parker.

narrative.whyChosen: Builder.io brought visual page building to headless commerce without sacrificing developer control.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved marketers and developers could share a composable frontend workflow.
narrative.problemSolved: Headless stacks left marketers unable to change landing pages without developer tickets.
